Thanks Jill — adding more color on the purchase paths and what we can provide for procurement: 

1) PO vs card vs marketplace:
   - PO (standard): supported — we accept PO + signed MSA. Typical timeline: procurement review (~1-2 weeks) + legal review on our side (1 week) for standard terms.
   - Card: supported for self-serve and lower-value pilots; for enterprise commit we generally move to PO to simplify invoicing and reporting.
   - AWS Marketplace: yes, Redwood is available on AWS Marketplace (listings & metered billing). If you prefer this route we can provide marketplace pricing & a marketplace quote; note that marketplace billing can add 1-2 weeks for setup depending on procurement team.

2) Documents we can provide immediately:
   - SOC2_Audit_Statement.pdf (redacted) — attached
   - Standard MSA + SOW template (I can attach a clean MSA)
   - Procurement packet with PO instructions and sample invoice (attached: ACME_PO_Process.pdf)

3) Pricing/quote: Attached Redwood_Quote_100k_20260323.pdf (draft). If you confirm budget cadence (annual vs quarterly) we can adapt the payment terms.

4) Proposed next steps:
   - Set a 30-min sync between Redwood (Marissa + me) and ACME procurement/finance to map approval owners and signatory path. Suggested slots: Tue 3/24 10:00-11:00am PT or Wed 3/25 2:00-3:00pm PT.
   - Jill to confirm economic buyer (Sarah) and procurement contact (Ben Rogers).
